**Job Summary**

**Job Title: US IT Recruiter**

**Company:**

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat — On-site

US Shift (7PM to 4 AM)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
Freshers

**Role Overview**

We are looking for fresh graduates from Computer Science or Information Technology backgrounds to join our recruitment team. You will support hiring for US IT positions by identifying suitable candidates, screening profiles, and coordinating the recruitment process.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Understand job requirements and the technical skills needed for each position.

• Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, Boolean searches, and referrals.

• Screen resumes and conduct initial conversations to assess candidate suitability, communication, availability, and interest.

• Coordinate interviews and follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.

• Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment trackers.

• Learn US recruitment processes, work authorizations, and employment types.

• Work toward assigned recruitment targets while maintaining candidate quality.

**Qualifications and Skills**

• B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or IT, BCA, MCA, B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science or IT, or a related qualification.

• Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

• Basic knowledge of programming languages, databases, and common IT roles.

• Good interpersonal, organizational, and follow-up skills.

• Willingness to learn sourcing techniques and recruitment tools.

• Ability to work in a target-oriented environment.

• Willingness to work US shifts from our Ahmedabad office.

The team is driven by a mission to simplify the startup ecosystem by reducing regulatory hurdles and addressing investor concerns, creating an environment where new ventures can scale confidently.

The Recruiting Intern is a full-time, on-site role based in

description:
**Company Description**
Carryfast Logistics Pvt Ltd is a premier third-party logistics service provider in India, focused on delivering high-performance solutions with strong operational efficiency. The organization is driven by a team of highly qualified and experienced logistics professionals who specialize in distribution and logistics management. Efficiency, timely delivery, and premium service are central to its commitment to customer satisfaction. With an expansive presence across multiple locations, Carryfast Logistics ensures reliable, scalable logistics support for diverse business needs. The company offers partners the opportunity to collaborate in a dynamic environment that values professionalism, responsiveness, and service excellence.

**Role Description**
The Manpower Agency Partner will be responsible for sourcing, supplying, and managing workforce requirements for Carryfast Logistics’ operations in the Greater Ahmedabad Area. This contract, on-site role includes coordinating with internal teams to understand manpower demands, aligning suitable candidates, and ensuring timely deployment of personnel across warehouses, distribution centers, and other logistics sites. * Experience in manpower supply, staffing, or recruitment services, ideally within logistics, warehousing, or supply chain environments.

* Ability to manage workforce planning, scheduling, and on-ground supervision at multiple sites in the Greater Ahmedabad Area.
* Proficiency in maintaining accurate records, documentation, and reports related to attendance, deployment, and contract workforce performance.
* Capability to operate in a fast-paced environment, respond quickly to changing manpower needs, and meet agreed service levels.
* Prior experience partnering with large organizations as a manpower or staffing vendor is highly beneficial.
* Access to an established manpower network and the ability to ramp up or down staffing volumes as required.
* Comfortable with on-site coordination and regular travel within the Greater Ahmedabad Area.

description:

–
**Placement Manager**

**SKIPS University, Greater Ahmedabad**

***Position Overview:***

As a Training and Placement Manager will play a pivotal role in connecting students with career opportunities by facilitating students’ training, skill development, and eventual placement in reputable organizations. This role requires strong communication skills, excellent networking abilities, and a keen understanding of both student needs and industry requirements.

***Key Responsibilities:***

The Placement Manager is required to
**visit 5 companies daily in Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar**
to coordinate with industry partners, recruiters, and potential employers for the following purposes:

1) Final placements

2) Summer internships

3) Live projects

4) Guest lectures (IIF Club)

5) Workshops

6) Industrial visits

8) Viva

9) Curriculum development

- Board of Studies member

* Establish and maintain relationships with industry partners, recruiters, and potential employers.
* Actively seek and secure internship and job opportunities for students through networking and outreach efforts.

**Training Coordination:**

* Coordinate workshops, seminars, and training sessions aimed at enhancing students' employability skills.
* Monitor training progress and provide feedback to students for continuous improvement.

* Participate in professional development activities and networking events to broaden industry connections and stay informed about best practices.

***Minimum Job Requirements:***

* Bachelor's degree; at least 5 year of experience directly related to the duties and responsibilities specified.
* Previous experience in career counseling, recruitment, or related fields within an educational setting is advantageous.

***Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:***

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with students, faculty, employers, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent organisational abilities and attention to detail, with the capacity to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with database management systems.
* Knowledge of industry trends, job market dynamics, and career development resources.
* Commitment to promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of student support and placement services.

title: Sr Recruiter (UK - Education)
description:
**UK Education Recruitment Specialist – Ahmedabad**

Are you a driven recruitment professional with a passion for education and people-focused hiring? Join our award-winning Ahmedabad team and help connect teachers, teaching assistants, SEN specialists, cover supervisors, school support staff, and education professionals with schools, academies, colleges, and education providers across the UK.

**Who We Are**

At IMS Group, we are an engine for global talent. With over 3,000 employees and a footprint spanning 250+ global clients across the APAC, EU, US, and APAC, we connect top-tier professionals with Fortune 500 companies. We are proud to be a 5-time consecutive winner of the Great Place to Work® award because we invest heavily in our people, offering world-class mentorship, health benefits, and long-term career growth.

**The Opportunity: What You Will Do**

As a UK Education Recruitment Specialist, you will manage recruitment delivery for UK-based education roles, supporting schools and candidates across supply, temporary, long-term, and permanent staffing requirements. Your day-to-day will focus on:

* **Education Talent Sourcing:**
  Identify, approach, and engage active and passive candidates across roles such as teachers, teaching assistants, SEN staff, cover supervisors, tutors, early years practitioners, administrators, and wider school support professionals.
* **End-to-End Recruitment Delivery:**
  Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from sourcing, screening, registration, shortlisting, interview coordination, candidate follow-up, booking support, offer management, and placement delivery.
* **School Briefing & Candidate Matching:**
  Qualify candidates against school requirements by understanding key stages, subject specialisms, SEN experience, classroom exposure, safeguarding expectations, location, availability, pay expectations, and assignment preferences.
* **Candidate, School & Data Management:**
  Build strong relationships with candidates, recruiters, school contacts, hiring managers, and client stakeholders while maintaining accurate records, pipeline updates, bookings, and recruitment activity in ATS or CRM systems.

**What You Bring to the Table**

We welcome applications from recruiters with experience in education recruitment, staffing, sourcing, teacher recruitment, school support recruitment, SEN recruitment, childcare recruitment, or other fast-paced, target-driven recruitment environments. We are looking for:

* **Recruitment or Sourcing Experience:**
  Experience handling candidate sourcing, screening, registration, shortlisting, interview coordination, pipeline management, booking support, or recruitment delivery in a fast-paced environment.
* **Education Market Awareness:**
  Understanding of UK education recruitment, school staffing, teacher supply, SEN, primary, secondary, early years, academies, colleges, or willingness to quickly learn specialist education hiring markets.
* **Communication, Pace & Ownership:**
  Strong written and verbal communication skills, excellent follow-up discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple vacancies, candidates, school contacts, and stakeholders against delivery targets.
* **Shift Flexibility:**
  UK shift alignment with Saturday and Sunday off.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* **Specialist Education Recruitment Exposure:**
  Build expertise across UK teacher recruitment, SEN, primary, secondary, early years, academies, colleges, supply staffing, permanent recruitment, and wider school support markets.
* **Work-Life Balance:**
  Structured UK shift alignment and a strict 5-day work week.
* **Career Growth:**
  Receive hands-on mentorship, structured training, and clear pathways to grow into a specialist UK education recruitment professional.
* **The Culture:**
  A recognized Great Place to Work® environment that champions health benefits, dynamic energy, and long-term professional development.

**Ready to Build With Us?**

If you have the drive, communication skills, and passion to connect talented education professionals with schools and learning communities across the UK, we want to hear from you.

title: Manager - Student Recruitment & Outreach
description:
**Company Description**
ECA Global is a leading private higher education group founded in Australia, with multiple higher education brands across Sydney, Brisbane, Melbourne, Perth, and Parramatta. The group has expanded internationally with new campuses in the UK and operational hubs in Europe, China, the Philippines, Brazil, Nepal, and India. Each year, ECA Global welcomes around 15,000 students from diverse backgrounds into its global network of campuses. The organization focuses on delivering high-quality education, international pathways, and student-centric support services. ECA Global offers a multicultural work environment and opportunities to engage with learners and partners worldwide.

Position Summary: The Manager – Student Recruitment will lead and execute student recruitment strategies to achieve enrolment targets, expand market presence, strengthen institutional partnerships, and improve student conversion rates. The role is responsible for driving recruitment operations, developing effective outreach initiatives, managing recruitment channels, and building strong relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, and other institutional partners.

The successful candidate will combine strategic planning, commercial acumen, market intelligence, operational excellence, and people leadership to deliver sustainable student recruitment growth. The role will also work closely with academic teams, Admissions, Student Services, and other internal stakeholders to ensure a seamless prospective student journey from initial enquiry through enrolment and onboarding.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment Strategy, Market Development & Partnerships**

* Develop and implement comprehensive student recruitment strategies aligned with institutional enrolment targets and business growth objectives.
* Identify priority markets, student segments, recruitment channels, and opportunities for market expansion.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, academic institutions, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop articulation agreements, feeder relationships, and student progression pathways to strengthen recruitment pipelines and improve conversion.
* Collaborate with academic teams to align recruitment campaigns, messaging, and market positioning with programme offerings and institutional priorities.
* Lead relationship development and stakeholder engagement across key domestic and international markets.
* Leverage market research, CRM insights, competitor analysis, and enrolment trends to inform recruitment strategies and identify new growth opportunities.
* Represent the institution at recruitment fairs, school visits, industry events, partner meetings, presentations, and other outreach activities.
* Identify and develop innovative recruitment channels, partnership models, and market penetration initiatives.
* Monitor the effectiveness of recruitment partnerships and implement strategies to improve partner engagement and performance.

**2. Recruitment Operations, Student Conversion & Performance Management**

* Manage the end-to-end student recruitment pipeline, from enquiry generation and application follow-up through offer acceptance, enrolment, and onboarding.
* Drive timely, accurate, and high-quality communication with prospective students, applicants, and recruitment partners.
* Monitor recruitment funnel performance and implement initiatives to improve enquiry-to-application, application-to-offer, and offer-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Plan, coordinate, and oversee recruitment campaigns, marketing communications, outreach activities, open days, education fairs, and student engagement events.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), recruitment targets, pipeline metrics, and channel performance.
* Analyse recruitment data, identify conversion bottlenecks, and recommend corrective actions to improve enrolment outcomes.
* Prepare regular performance reports, market insights, pipeline updates, and strategic recommendations for senior management.
* Manage education agent performance, evaluate channel effectiveness, and implement appropriate performance improvement measures.
* Work closely with Admissions, Student Services, Marketing, and academic teams to ensure efficient application processing and a seamless student experience.
* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, reporting frameworks, and quality assurance practices.
* Coordinate recruitment calendars, campaign timelines, event logistics, and competing operational priorities to ensure timely execution.
* Ensure recruitment activities deliver against agreed enrolment targets, service standards, and institutional growth objectives.

**3. Leadership, Team Management & Capability Development**

* Lead, motivate, and manage recruitment and outreach teams, where applicable, to achieve individual and collective performance targets.
* Set clear objectives, allocate responsibilities, monitor performance, and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Build a high-performing, accountable, student-focused, and commercially driven recruitment culture.
* Develop team capabilities through training, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous professional development.
* Foster collaboration across recruitment, marketing, admissions, academic, and student support functions.
* Introduce innovative recruitment approaches, student engagement initiatives, and outreach models to enhance productivity and market penetration.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen recruitment processes.
* Oversee recruitment-related budgets, campaign expenditure, event planning, and resource allocation, as applicable.
* Promote data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and accountability for recruitment outcomes.
* Support succession planning, capability development, and the effective use of team resources to meet evolving business needs.

**4. Compliance, Governance & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure recruitment practices comply with institutional policies, applicable regulatory requirements, and relevant quality assurance standards.
* Uphold equal opportunity, workplace health and safety (OSH), data privacy, and information security requirements.
* Ensure appropriate handling of prospective student and applicant information in accordance with applicable data protection requirements, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), where applicable.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records, partner documentation, performance reports, and operational records.
* Promote ethical recruitment practices, transparent communication, and a positive student experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Escalate recruitment risks, operational challenges, compliance concerns, and performance gaps in a timely manner.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be assessed against agreed institutional and departmental objectives, including:

* Achievement of student enrolment targets by programme, market, and recruitment channel.
* Improvement in enquiry-to-application and application-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Growth in qualified student enquiries and recruitment pipeline volume.
* Effectiveness and productivity of education agents and institutional partnerships.
* Delivery and performance of recruitment campaigns, outreach activities, and events.
* Timeliness and quality of applicant communication and follow-up.
* Accuracy of recruitment data, reporting, and pipeline forecasting.
* Compliance with institutional policies, recruitment processes, and applicable regulations.
* Team productivity, target achievement, and professional development.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Education, International Relations, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification or relevant professional certification will be an advantage.
* Significant experience in student recruitment, education management, business development, institutional partnerships, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and executing recruitment strategies and achieving measurable enrolment or business growth targets.
* Proven experience managing recruitment pipelines, conversion processes, performance metrics, and stakeholder relationships.
* Experience developing and managing relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, or institutional partners.
* Previous experience leading or supervising teams, setting performance targets, and driving accountability will be highly desirable.
* Experience in higher education, international education, or a multi-campus education environment will be an advantage.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Strategic thinking:**
  Ability to translate institutional growth objectives into practical recruitment strategies and actionable plans.
* **Business development:**
  Strong partnership-building, networking, negotiation, and market expansion capabilities.
* **Performance management:**
  Ability to establish KPIs, analyse recruitment data, identify trends, and drive measurable improvements.
* **Communication and presentation:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication, public speaking, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* **Leadership:**
  Ability to motivate teams, manage performance, develop talent, and foster a results-oriented culture.
* **Operational management:**
  Strong planning, organisational, prioritisation, budgeting, and execution capabilities.
* **Analytical ability:**
  Proficiency in interpreting market intelligence, CRM data, conversion metrics, and performance reports.
* **Relationship management:**
  Ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with diverse internal and external stakeholders.

- Ability to manage multiple recruitment and HR operational activities independently.

- Good organizational skills, attention to detail, and a professional approach.

- Ability to work closely with the HR Head and support daily HR requirements.

### Preferred Candidate Profile

A responsible and well-organized HR professional who is strong in IT recruitment and employee lifecycle management. The candidate should be capable of independently handling recruitment and routine HR operations while assisting the HR Head with documentation, employee coordination, onboarding, exits, and other assigned responsibilities.

\*\*Note:\*\* Payroll processing, salary calculations, and payroll management are handled by the HR Head and are not part of this role.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities-

• Build working relationships with business stakeholders, TA leadership and key HR contacts on the account, and across

the wider Taggd business.

• Act as the single point of contact for all recruitment, sourcing and strategy matters raised with the RPO team.

• Hold a weekly, monthly and quarterly review rhythm with the hiring manager community and senior business

stakeholders, covering pipeline health, SLA status and open escalations.

**Job Description - Manager – Talent Solutions**

• Seek stakeholder feedback actively and close out every item with a documented action.

• Communicate process changes, new initiatives and additional service offerings to stakeholders as they are introduced.

**Delivery and Operations**

• Deliver the agreed annual hiring plan, tracked as a monthly fulfilment percentage against plan.

• Hold time-to-fill within the contracted SLA for each role band and review every ageing requisition in the weekly account review.

• Review team, recruiting numbers and SLA performance on a set cadence, and act on any measure falling below

benchmark.

• Maintain offer-to-join conversion at 85% or above through structured candidate engagement from offer release to date

of joining.

• Ensure governance and compliance across policy, process and procedure, with zero audit exceptions on the account.

**Sourcing and Talent Pipeline**

• Lead hands-on sourcing for critical and niche mandates; head-hunt for roles that portals cannot fill.

• Gain a working understanding of the assigned business — structure, nature of work and challenges faced — so that

sourcing strategy is built against anticipated demand rather than live vacancies alone.

• Build and maintain ready pipelines of active and passive candidates for repeat-demand and hard-to-fill roles.

• Engage specialised, high-skilled and difficult-to-attract talent through professional networks, portals and direct

approach.

**Market Intelligence and Reporting**

• Analyse recruitment trends, results and insights — business unit, client and external market — and share them with

the client and Taggd peers to shape future hiring activity.

• Share market intelligence — talent availability, compensation trends, competitor movement — in every monthly

review.

**People Management**

• Create KPIs for every team member on the HRMS and manage performance against them through the year.

• Plan and track training so the team is set up to deliver against its targets.

• Run structured engagement connects and build a documented career path for each team member

**Candidate Profile-**

This role suits someone who has already run a recruitment team against a hiring plan, not someone stepping into team

management for the first time. The successful candidate will:

• Bring 8+ years in search or RPO delivery, including experience leading a team of 10+ recruiters. Candidates who have

not managed at this scale will not be considered.

• Have hired at volume in manufacturing, automobile, auto component, heavy machinery, OEM or electric vehicle

businesses, and know where the talent sits and what it costs. This sector exposure is a requirement of the role, not a

preference.

• Still source personally on the mandates that matter, through head-hunting, Boolean and advanced search, portals and

professional networks.

• Hold their own with business heads and senior HR stakeholders, and hold a consultative hiring conversation rather

than take an order.

• Communicate with authority in writing and in the room.

• Work to a target and carry a delivery orientation into the team.

• Be fluent with ATS and database management, and advanced in MS Office.

• Be a graduate in any discipline; a postgraduate qualification or an MBA or PGDM in Human Resources is preferred.

• Source with AI-driven search and AI-enabled tools — CV matching, Gen AI Boolean strings and adverts, automated

outreach — and measure what each one actually yields.

• Run the weekly delivery dashboard and the monthly account MIS, and act on what the numbers show rather than only

reporting them.

• Build recruiter capability — find the skill gaps across the team, coach against them, and add capability where the plan

needs it.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities

* **Employee Relations:**
  Maintain a harmonious, productive and union-free work climate through strong shop-floor connect, an open-door policy, effective Works Committee and Grievance Redressal Committee, and regular communication forums; identify and address early signs of unrest or external influence.
* **Discipline & Legal Matters:**
  Handle misconduct cases end-to-end – show-cause notices, charge-sheets, domestic enquiries and final orders – as per Standing Orders and principles of natural justice; manage conciliation and labour court matters with legal counsel.
* **Statutory Compliance:**
  Ensure 100% compliance with the four Labour Codes, state rules and allied laws; manage factory and contract-labour licences, PF, ESI, LWF, bonus, gratuity, registers and returns; handle inspections and run a monthly compliance calendar with quarterly internal audits.
* **Contract Labour Governance:**
  Govern contractor empanelment, licence checks, onboarding, wage and PF/ESI verification; ensure principal-employer obligations and prevent sham-contracting risks.
* **HR Business Partnering:**
  Partner with the Plant Head and HODs on manpower planning, productivity, manpower cost per tonne, absenteeism and overtime control; lead plant hiring, including apprentices and trainees.
* **Talent & Capability:**
  Drive performance management, succession for critical roles and the plant training calendar (technical, safety, 5S/TPM and supervisory skills).
* **Engagement & Welfare:**
  Run engagement and recognition programmes; oversee medical and other statutory welfare facilities; ensure the POSH Internal Committee functions effectively.
* **HR Operations & MIS:**
  Oversee time office and payroll inputs; drive HRMS digitisation, monthly HR MIS and the plant HR budget.
* **Safety & Governance:**
  Partner with EHS on behavioural safety and accident cases; support Code of Conduct and customer social-compliance audits.
* **Team Leadership:**
  Lead and develop the plant HR team and build a strong second line.

Statutory Knowledge Required

Strong working knowledge of the Code on Wages, Industrial Relations Code, Code on Social Security and OSH Code with applicable Rajasthan state rules; the Factories Act, CLRA, Standing Orders and other legacy laws where still relevant; POSH Act, Apprentices Act, LWF and Shops & Establishments laws; and domestic enquiry procedure and key labour judgments.

Key Performance Indicators

* No production loss due to employee-relations issues; union-free status maintained
* 100% statutory compliance; zero penalties or major inspection observations
* Contractor compliance and timely closure of audit gaps
* Absenteeism, overtime and manpower cost within budget
* Critical-talent attrition, hiring TAT, training man-days and engagement scores on target

Qualifications & Experience

* **Education:**
  MBA / PGDM / MA / MSW in HR, Personnel Management, IR or Labour Welfare; LLB or Diploma in Labour Laws preferred.
* **Experience:**
  12–18 years in HR, including at least 8 years in plant HR / IR in metals, steel, auto, engineering or other heavy manufacturing; experience of handling a 1,000+ permanent and contract workforce.
* **Skills:**
  Hands-on HRMS / payroll systems and Excel-based MIS; fluency in English and Hindi (local language preferred).

Key Competencies

* **Functional:**
  Employee relations, labour-law compliance, domestic enquiries, workforce planning and HR analytics.
* **Behavioural:**
  Integrity and firmness, conflict resolution, business acumen, stakeholder influence, composure under pressure, approachability and team leadership.

Key Stakeholders

* **Internal:**
  Plant Head, HODs, Corporate HR, Legal, employees and supervisors.
* **External:**
  Contractors, Labour Department, Factory Inspectorate, PF / ESI offices, local administration, labour courts and legal counsel.

Founder and CEO (U.S.)

**About STEPS Talent**

STEPS Talent is a U.S. enterprise technology staffing company with a growing India company, STEPS Talent Consulting Private Limited. We place ERP, Cloud, Data and AI, Cybersecurity and Software Engineering professionals with enterprise clients in the United States and India. We are establishing Ahmedabad as our permanent India headquarters and hiring the person who will run it.

**The role**

This is a founding operator role. You will not inherit a finished system. You will build one.

This is not an HR Manager, Finance Manager or administrative role. It is a hands-on business operator who knows how a staffing company runs behind the scenes.

**You own India business and financial operations end to end:**
controls, monthly close, management reporting, intercompany billing with the U.S., HR and payroll oversight, statutory compliance, and the relationships with our Chartered Accountants, Company Secretary and bankers. You set up the Ahmedabad office and lead key corporate and banking projects. You build the Business Operations team under you. And you work directly with the Founder and CEO, with no layers in between.

**What you will build in year one**

* A finance and controls function that U.S. leadership can trust without checking the work twice: approval workflows, segregation of duties, auditable records
* The Ahmedabad office: premises, vendors, infrastructure, people
* A steady working rhythm with our Chartered Accountants, Company Secretary and bankers: clear handoffs, complete documentation, deadlines met without reminders
* HR, payroll and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, TDS, Professional Tax) run by a specialist you hire and manage
* Oversight of staffing back-office operations: consultant onboarding, timesheets, billing and client portals
* The reporting rhythm: one monthly view of cash, billing, payroll, compliance and open issues
* The systems backbone across Zoho Books, Tally, HRMS and our staffing platforms

**What good looks like at 90 days**

* Monthly close, reporting and compliance running on schedule without CEO intervention
* The Ahmedabad office and professional relationships operating with clear ownership
* The first management dashboard live, and a prioritized systems plan for the next two quarters

**Who does well here**

* 10+ years in business operations, ideally IT staffing or professional services, with hands-on ownership of India finance operations: monthly close, reconciliations, vendor payments, payroll controls, management reporting
* Has worked directly with Chartered Accountants, tax professionals and payroll providers, and keeps ownership inside the company
* Reads a P&L, balance sheet and cash flow and turns them into management action
* 5+ years managing people; working knowledge of Indian HR, payroll and employment compliance
* Working knowledge of U.S. staffing back-office operations: consultant lifecycle, W-2 and C2C, timesheets, client billing
* Has built processes, controls and reporting in a growing company and been personally accountable for the result. Been there, done that
* A problem-solver who owns outcomes: resolves issues at their level, escalates with options rather than questions, and does not need the CEO to close every open item
* Clear writer and speaker; discreet; comfortable working directly with U.S. leadership

**Preferred:**
Zoho Books, Zoho People, Tally, QuickBooks or comparable systems; SAP Fieldglass, SAP Ariba or similar MSP and VMS platforms; intercompany billing across related companies in different countries; setting up a new office or managing external advisers.

**Why this role**

* Founding seat in a new India headquarters, with the authority to design how it runs
* Direct line to the CEO. Your work is seen, and your decisions carry
* Cross-border scope: U.S. and India finance, tax, compliance and staffing operations in one role
* A path to Head of India Business Operations as the company grows
